paragraphs.text: The Daraja Plains (dah-rah-jah ) are a calm, tranquil region populated by a great many birds and griffins on Dominaria . Located at the base of the Talruum Mountains , Daraja was bordered by the Mwonvuli Jungle of southern Suq’Ata in the north-east. It functioned as a neutral zone between Zhalfir and Suq'Ata

As part of Zhalfir, the Daraja Plains were phased out alongside other parts of north-western Jamuraa since the planeswalker Teferi wanted to spare it from the horrors of the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria . They were forever lost from Dominaria when Jeska destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.
The plains were returned to the multiverse during the New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch after the New Phyrexian Invasion . They now exist as part of the plane of Zhalfir.
The plains' name is derived from the Swahili word for "bridge", referring to their position bridging Zhalfir and Suq'Ata.
